title: How to Clean a MacBook Screen and Keyboard (Safely)
hook: Fingerprints on the screen, crumbs under the keys. But clean a MacBook the wrong way, and you can scratch the display or damage the keyboard. Here are seven safe steps, with just a cloth and a little water. Stay for step three: it's where most damage happens.
intro: A MacBook is easy to clean if you respect two rules: use as little liquid as possible, and never spray anything directly onto the computer. Moisture in the keyboard or the speakers causes real damage. We'll follow Apple's own advice, step by step, in good light.
youNeedNarration: You'll need two microfiber cloths, a little distilled water, a can of compressed air, and, to disinfect the outside, seventy percent isopropyl wipes. No household sprays.
heroImagePrompt: A silver MacBook open on a bright white desk with a folded microfiber cloth beside it, soft morning light, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Shut down and unplug
steps.narration: Step one. Before you clean anything, turn the MacBook off completely, and unplug the charger and any cables or accessories. A powered-off computer can't be damaged by a stray drop of moisture, and you'll see dust and smudges more clearly on a dark screen. Let the laptop cool down if it has been working hard. Then place it on a clean, flat surface with good light. This only takes thirty seconds, but it is the step that protects your computer, so please don't skip it. If you use an external monitor or a mouse, unplug those too.
steps.mistake: Cleaning while the Mac is still on
steps.imagePrompt: A person closing a MacBook lid on a clean desk beside an unplugged white charger, soft daylight, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Dust the screen first
steps.narration: Step two. Take a dry, soft microfiber cloth and wipe the screen gently in one direction, from top to bottom. Dry wiping removes dust and grit first, so you won't drag them across the glass when you add moisture. Use light pressure, and don't press hard on the display, because the panel is thin and pressure can leave marks. Don't use paper towels, tissues or kitchen cloths, which have rough fibres that can leave tiny scratches over time. A good microfiber cloth lasts for years and can be washed. Always check the cloth is clean before you start, because one trapped grain of sand can scratch the screen.
steps.mistake: Using paper towels on the display
steps.imagePrompt: A hand wiping a laptop display with a folded microfiber cloth in slow vertical strokes, bright desk, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Wipe with a damp cloth
steps.narration: Step three. For fingerprints that remain, slightly dampen a clean microfiber cloth with water. It should be barely damp, not wet, so squeeze out any excess. Wipe the screen gently in the same top to bottom motion. Apple recommends water only for its displays, so skip window cleaners, alcohol, vinegar, and any household sprays, which can strip the anti-glare coating. Never spray liquid directly onto the screen or the keyboard. If you see a stubborn spot, go over it again with the damp cloth, gently, without scrubbing. Patience works better than pressure, and a clean screen only takes a minute.
steps.mistake: Spraying cleaner directly on the screen
steps.imagePrompt: A slightly damp microfiber cloth wiping a fingerprint smudge off a laptop screen, close-up, soft light, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Dry and check for streaks
steps.narration: Step four. Go over the screen with your second, dry microfiber cloth, using the same gentle strokes. This removes any moisture left behind, and stops streaks from forming. Then tilt the lid toward a window or lamp, and look along the surface at an angle, where streaks and missed spots are easiest to see. If you spot any, repeat the damp and dry steps lightly on just that area. Leave the lid open for a minute so any trace of moisture evaporates, before you close the MacBook. This final check also protects the keyboard from marking the screen when the lid closes.
steps.tip: Check the screen at an angle
steps.mistake: Closing the lid on a damp screen
steps.imagePrompt: A MacBook screen reflecting window light at an angle, showing a perfectly clean surface, close-up, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Clear crumbs from the keyboard
steps.narration: Step five. Hold the MacBook at about a seventy-five degree angle, so the keys tilt toward you. Using the thin straw on the compressed air can, spray in short bursts across the keyboard in a left to right motion. Rotate the MacBook to its right side and repeat, then to its left side and repeat one more time. Keep the can upright, and don't shake it, so no liquid comes out. This lifts crumbs and dust from under the keys. Never use a vacuum cleaner, since static can harm the computer. If a key still feels stuck afterwards, repeat the process once more, and book a service visit if it doesn't improve.
steps.mistake: Shaking or tilting the compressed air can
steps.imagePrompt: A can of compressed air blowing dust from a MacBook keyboard held at an angle, desk lamp light, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Wipe the keys and trackpad
steps.narration: Step six. Lightly dampen a corner of your cloth, or use a seventy percent isopropyl alcohol wipe, and wipe the keys and the trackpad. Apple says these wipes are fine on the outside surfaces of the computer. Work key by key, using light pressure, and keep any moisture out of the gaps between the keys. Don't use bleach or hydrogen peroxide. If a key is sticky, wipe it a second time. This is also a good moment to clean the palm rests, where oils from your hands build up. Avoid getting wet cloths near the ports, the speaker holes and the fan vents.
steps.tip: Use a corner of the cloth only
steps.mistake: Letting liquid run between the keys
steps.imagePrompt: Fingers wiping the keys of a MacBook keyboard with a small alcohol wipe, macro view, photorealistic, no text

steps.title: Keep it clean for longer
steps.narration: Step seven. Finish by wiping the outside case and the bottom with the damp cloth, avoiding the ports, speaker grilles and vents. Then build a few habits. Wash and dry your hands before you work, and avoid eating over the keyboard. Wipe the screen once a week with the dry cloth. And before closing the lid, make sure nothing is on the keyboard, such as a pen or a camera cover thicker than a sheet of paper, since these can mark or crack the display. A two minute weekly wipe keeps your Mac looking new, and helps its resale value as well.
steps.mistake: Closing the lid on a pen or cover
steps.imagePrompt: A closed silver MacBook resting on a tidy wooden desk next to a notebook and a plant, natural light, photorealistic, no text

bonus.label: NOT WORKING?
bonus.title: If marks will not come off
bonus.narration: If a smudge stays, your cloth is probably the problem. A dirty cloth just moves grease around, so use a fresh one, and wash used cloths with mild soap and no fabric softener. Never scrape a mark with a fingernail. Faint marks may be wear on the coating, which no cleaning will remove.
bonus.tip: A clean cloth beats more pressure
bonus.imagePrompt: A MacBook-style silver laptop with the screen tilted toward a window, faint fingerprint smudges visible in the light, clean desk. Photorealistic photograph for a how-to video. Bright natural light, clean and uncluttered. 16:9 landscape format. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

bonus.label: CALL A PRO
bonus.title: When to contact Apple
bonus.narration: If keys stick or stop working after cleaning, ask Apple or an authorized service provider. The same goes for lines or dead spots on the display. If the case bulges or the trackpad seems to lift, stop using the laptop and have the battery checked, because a swollen battery can be unsafe.
bonus.imagePrompt: A silver laptop lying closed on a repair counter next to a small screwdriver set, bright shop lighting, no people visible. Photorealistic photograph for a how-to video. Bright natural light, clean and uncluttered. 16:9 landscape format. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

bonus.label: KEEP IT CLEAN
bonus.title: Keep it clean between wipes
bonus.narration: Keep a clean microfiber cloth in a small pouch in your bag, so grit never scratches the screen. Replace the cloth when it looks worn. Do not leave the laptop in a hot car or in direct sun for hours, and carry it in a padded sleeve.
bonus.tip: Keep a clean cloth in a pouch
bonus.imagePrompt: A folded gray microfiber cloth in a small pouch next to a padded laptop sleeve on a desk, soft daylight. Photorealistic photograph for a how-to video. Bright natural light, clean and uncluttered. 16:9 landscape format. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

mistakesToAvoid.narration: Let's go through the mistakes to avoid. First, never spray any liquid directly on the MacBook. It can flow into the keyboard and speakers and cause damage that isn't covered by warranty. Second, don't use glass cleaner, bleach, vinegar or aerosols, as they can strip the coating from the screen. And third, don't scrub or press hard. A gentle touch and a clean cloth beat force every time, and the display can be marked easily by pressure. If you ever spill a drink on the keyboard, switch it off at once, unplug it, and contact Apple, before you try to clean it yourself.
items: Spraying liquid directly on the laptop
Using glass cleaner, bleach or vinegar

recap.narration: Let's go through the whole routine one more time. Shut down and unplug. Dust the screen with a dry cloth. Wipe with a barely damp cloth. Dry it and check for streaks. Clear crumbs with short bursts of air. Wipe the keys and trackpad. And keep the Mac clean with a few small habits. Seven steps, five minutes, and a MacBook that looks cared for. The bonus sections cover stubborn marks, Apple and daily care.

outro: That's how you clean a MacBook screen and keyboard safely. If your Mac looks like new again, subscribe to WikiTube, because we publish a new how-to every single day. Tell us in the comments which device you would like us to clean next, whether that is a phone, a tablet or a TV. See you tomorrow.

metadata.title: How to Clean a MacBook Screen and Keyboard (Safely)
metadata.description:
Dirty MacBook screen or sticky keyboard? In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to clean a MacBook screen and keyboard safely: shut down, dust the display, wipe with a damp microfiber cloth, remove streaks, clear crumbs with compressed air, and wipe the keys and trackpad. We use only water, microfiber and a little isopropyl alcohol, with no sprays that could damage the screen. Works for MacBook Air and MacBook Pro.

You'll need: two microfiber cloths, a little distilled water, compressed air, 70 percent isopropyl wipes.

WikiTube publishes a new step-by-step how-to video every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

es.title: Cómo limpiar la pantalla y el teclado de un MacBook (sin riesgos)
es.description:
¿Pantalla con huellas o teclado sucio? En este vídeo paso a paso aprenderás a limpiar la pantalla y el teclado de un MacBook de forma segura: apagar, quitar el polvo, pasar un paño de microfibra humedecido, eliminar las marcas, sacar las migas con aire comprimido y limpiar las teclas y el trackpad. Solo agua, microfibra y un poco de alcohol isopropílico, sin aerosoles.

WikiTube publica un nuevo tutorial paso a paso cada día. Suscríbete para no perderte el siguiente.

pt.title: Como limpar a tela e o teclado do MacBook com segurança
pt.description:
Tela com marcas de dedos ou teclado sujo? Neste vídeo passo a passo você aprende a limpar a tela e o teclado do MacBook com segurança: desligar, tirar o pó, passar um pano de microfibra levemente úmido, remover marcas, soprar migalhas com ar comprimido e limpar teclas e trackpad. Apenas água, microfibra e um pouco de álcool isopropílico, sem sprays.

A WikiTube publica um novo tutorial passo a passo todos os dias. Inscreva-se para não perder o próximo.

fr.title: Comment nettoyer l'écran et le clavier d'un MacBook en toute sécurité
fr.description:
Écran plein de traces ou clavier sale ? Dans cette vidéo pas à pas, apprenez à nettoyer l'écran et le clavier d'un MacBook en toute sécurité : éteindre, dépoussiérer, passer un chiffon microfibre légèrement humide, supprimer les traces, chasser les miettes à l'air comprimé et nettoyer les touches et le trackpad. Seulement de l'eau, de la microfibre et un peu d'alcool isopropylique, sans spray.

WikiTube publie chaque jour un nouveau tutoriel pas à pas. Abonnez-vous pour ne pas manquer le prochain.

de.title: MacBook-Display und Tastatur sicher reinigen
de.description:
Fingerabdrücke auf dem Display oder eine verschmutzte Tastatur? In diesem Video lernst du Schritt für Schritt, wie du Display und Tastatur deines MacBooks sicher reinigst: ausschalten, abstauben, mit einem leicht feuchten Mikrofasertuch wischen, Schlieren entfernen, Krümel mit Druckluft ausblasen und Tasten sowie Trackpad säubern. Nur Wasser, Mikrofaser und etwas Isopropanol, keine Sprays.

WikiTube veröffentlicht jeden Tag eine neue Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung. Abonniere den Kanal, um die nächste nicht zu verpassen.

hi.title: मैकबुक की स्क्रीन और कीबोर्ड को सुरक्षित तरीके से कैसे साफ करें
hi.description:
स्क्रीन पर उंगलियों के निशान या गंदा कीबोर्ड? इस स्टेप-बाय-स्टेप वीडियो में सीखें मैकबुक की स्क्रीन और कीबोर्ड को सुरक्षित तरीके से कैसे साफ करें: बंद करें, धूल हटाएं, हल्के गीले माइक्रोफ़ाइबर कपड़े से पोंछें, धारियां हटाएं, कंप्रेस्ड एयर से टुकड़े निकालें और कीज़ व ट्रैकपैड साफ करें। सिर्फ़ पानी, माइक्रोफ़ाइबर और थोड़ी आइसोप्रोपाइल अल्कोहल, कोई स्प्रे नहीं।

WikiTube पर हर दिन एक नया स्टेप-बाय-स्टेप ट्यूटोरियल आता है। अगला वीडियो न छूटे, इसलिए सब्सक्राइब करें।

it.title: Come pulire schermo e tastiera del MacBook in sicurezza
it.description:
Schermo pieno di ditate o tastiera sporca? In questo video passo passo scopri come pulire schermo e tastiera del MacBook in sicurezza: spegnere, rimuovere la polvere, passare un panno in microfibra appena umido, eliminare gli aloni, soffiare via le briciole con aria compressa e pulire tasti e trackpad. Solo acqua, microfibra e un po' di alcol isopropilico, senza spray.

WikiTube pubblica ogni giorno un nuovo tutorial passo passo. Iscriviti per non perdere il prossimo.

ja.title: MacBookの画面とキーボードを安全に掃除する方法
ja.description:
画面の指紋やキーボードの汚れが気になりませんか？このステップ解説では、MacBookの画面とキーボードを安全に掃除する方法を紹介します。電源を切る、ホコリを払う、少し湿らせたマイクロファイバーで拭く、筋を取る、エアダスターでゴミを飛ばす、キーとトラックパッドを拭くまで。使うのは水、マイクロファイバー、少量のイソプロピルアルコールだけで、スプレーは使いません。

id.title: Cara Membersihkan Layar dan Keyboard MacBook dengan Aman
id.description:
Layar penuh sidik jari atau keyboard kotor? Dalam video langkah demi langkah ini, Anda akan belajar membersihkan layar dan keyboard MacBook dengan aman: matikan perangkat, bersihkan debu, usap dengan kain mikrofiber yang sedikit lembap, hilangkan bekas, tiup remah dengan udara bertekanan, lalu bersihkan tombol dan trackpad. Hanya air, mikrofiber, dan sedikit alkohol isopropil, tanpa semprotan.

WikiTube menerbitkan tutorial langkah demi langkah baru setiap hari. Subscribe agar tidak ketinggalan video berikutnya.

short.title: Never spray your MacBook screen #shorts
short.description: Power off, damp microfiber, compressed air. Full 7-step guide on the channel. #macbook #cleaning #howto
short.hook: Never spray cleaner on your MacBook screen. Clean it this way instead.

steps.title: Power off
steps.narration: One. Shut the MacBook down and unplug everything.

steps.title: Barely damp cloth
steps.narration: Two. Wipe the screen with a barely damp microfiber cloth. Never spray liquid on it.

steps.title: Air for the keys
steps.narration: Three. Tilt the laptop and use short bursts of compressed air across the keyboard.
